verdict: CASE REPORT (GATA1, K562; case_report.py): one knockout end-to-end, establishing what CHANGED at every hop rather than merely traversing it. LAST PHOTO: 250 genes moved -- 17 generic tide + 233 GATA1-specific; the knocked-out protein's own chromatin activity is -2.60z, so its regulatory function is measurably lost. NAMING: 230/233 reachable by a curated chain within 4 hops, 3 unreachable -- but reachability alone is worthless: discrimination between real movers and non-movers collapses from 3.6x at 1 hop to 1.0x at 4 hops, so long chains are connectivity, not mechanism. THE PER-HOP STATE AUDIT over 157 distinct intermediate proteins: 3 actually changed ABUNDANCE as their edge requires; 4 changed the OPPOSITE way (in this cell those proteins are NOT working as annotated); 16 kept a flat mRNA but show CHANGED CHROMATIN ACTIVITY -- function altered with level held constant, i.e. loss-of-function invisible to abundance; 14 were tested on BOTH layers and showed no change (the strongest evidence a link did not fire); and 120 could not be tested at all. THE COVERAGE CAVEAT IS DECISIVE: only 32/157 intermediates even have a chromVAR motif, so the activity layer could only be interrogated for a minority -- the large 'cannot tell' class is a limit of the DATA, not a biological finding. Only 17/230 named chains are operative end to end (every protein on them demonstrably changed). MEANING: a pathway drawn through this graph is mostly a claim about connectivity; demand that each protein on it actually changed -- in level or in measured activity -- and most chains do not survive, a few are contradicted outright, and the largest class is simply untestable with an abundance readout. That is precisely where a genome-wide activity readout is required. (Self-audit corrections applied: 1-hop targets no longer auto-pass as operative, and 'defended' now requires essentiality -- an earlier rule counting rarely-moving genes captured 93.5% of the genome and was vacuous.) Deterministic.
